description: Cloudflare WAF rules for the LoveHub push-relay Worker (lovehub-push.lehuuluan00.workers.dev).
notes: Apply via `wrangler` rules or the Cloudflare dashboard.
These rules defend the entry point that delivers push notifications.
Real Firestore / Groq endpoints have their own Google Cloud Armor.

rules.name: block_bot_user_agents
rules.expression: (lower(http.user_agent) contains "bot" and lower(http.user_agent) != "googlebot") or lower(http.user_agent) contains "crawler" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "spider" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scrapy" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "curl" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "python-requests"
rules.comment: Block obvious non-mobile clients. Allow Googlebot for SEO.

rules.name: block_no_referer
rules.comment: Force JS challenge when no Referer header (real app always sends one).

rules.name: rate_limit_per_couple
rules.comment: 200 pushes/hour per coupleId. Higher than expected usage.

rules.name: require_https
rules.comment: Reject plain HTTP (already handled by network_security_config but belt-and-braces).

rules.name: block_known_tor_exits
rules.comment: Refresh the IP list weekly. Use cf.threat_score > 50 as a cheaper proxy if Tor list is stale.

rules.name: block_high_threat_score
rules.comment: Cloudflare-assigned threat score; > 50 is highly suspicious.

rules.name: geo_block_high_risk
rules.comment: Vietnam-only target audience. Adjust per business reality.

rules.name: log_all_admin_endpoints
rules.comment: Audit-trail all admin/debug hits even if allowed.

bot_management.comment: Cloudflare Bot Management — paid add-on. Score 30 catches most simple scrapers.

rate_limit_ip_lists.name: blocklist_known_offenders
rate_limit_ip_lists.comment: Maintain via Cloudflare IP Lists API; add IPs caught by audit logger.
